name: Sculptor: sensor field at scale
summary: Rework a three.js r186 terrain and sensor-pin scene module so it scales to real surveys, stays correct as data changes and frees GPU memory.
prompt: The sensor field view in src/field.mjs was built against our 200-sensor demo survey. On real surveys it crawls, and GPU memory grows every time someone opens and closes the view. Please rework src/field.mjs so it meets BRIEF.md, keeping the exported API the app already calls. The app ships three.js r186; it is not installed here and there is no network, so you cannot run three. Do not install packages.

checks.label: Sensor pins match the survey within the draw-call budget
Pins show and update their status colours
Moving sensors keeps pins visible and clickable
Replacing the sensor list draws exactly the new set
Terrain surface matches the survey grid
Closing the view frees memory and restores the scene
